Symptom: Nightly export to Content Hub skips documents
Fix: Add the class mapping, rerun the export

Check: Event log on the application server

Symptom: Upload slow for one tenant in the evening
Search returns nothing for one tenant
Cause: Index job for that tenant's folder stalled
Fix: Restart the index worker, re-queue the folder

Symptom: Document opens with a render error
Cause: Render cache holds a broken preview
Fix: Clear the render cache entry, re-render

Symptom: Alert mail, transfer timeout for one document ID
Cause: Target busy during the night batch
Check: transfer.log and index.log for the ID

Symptom: OCR failed on many pages of one batch
Check: Scan quality in the batch preview
Fix: Send the batch back for rescanning

Symptom: Index worker stops with disk warning
Check: Free space on the worker's temp folder
Fix: Stop the worker, clear the temp folder, start it

Symptom: Web viewer fails to open documents, API works

Check: Cleanup task schedule and last run
Fix: Run the cleanup task; check retention setting

Symptom: File not found for a document that search lists
Cause: Document moved during migration, index points to the old path

Symptom: Search by date returns wrong year
Cause: Date field stored as text for old classes
Fix: Search by archive ID instead; fix planned

Symptom: Batch stuck at the remote site
Cause: Export to target failed and was not retried
Check: Batch state at the remote site

Fix: Ask the network team to restart the site VPN
